The unit's own file alone ('pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/diagnosisRoutes.test.ts') has 70 tests, green in 6 repeated runs.

POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses has no guard for archived companies (the PRD lists none); the UI is expected not to offer 'Novo diagnóstico' on an archived company page. A 409 guard can be added in diagnosisRepository.startDraft if wanted.

Not run (outside this unit): pnpm test:e2e (tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts, AC-dm-12/14/16/17/48 on screen), AC-dm-27 timing in the Play, and 'aioson harness:check'. They need the frontend units and the integration build.

messages.text: IF-003 as implemented. POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses -> 201 new draft or 200 existing draft (same body shape). Diagnosis body: id, companyId, status, answers, calculator (always the full CalculatorInput, nulls and spendParts {} when empty), currentBlock, updatedAt, rulesVersion|null, result|null, previous|null, plus additive createdAt and completedAt (ISO or null). PATCH is partial and strict: answers merge per question id, calculator merges per top-level key (spendParts, when sent, replaces the whole parts object; null clears a field), currentBlock 1..8; any other key (status, result, stage...) is 400. 400 validation_failed carries fields keyed 'answers.<id>', 'calculator.<key>' or 'currentBlock'. Answer null is only accepted for mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1, co1. Money is integer cents 0..MONEY_MAX_CENTS, newCustomers 0..1000000, marginPercent 0..100 integers. PATCH/DELETE on a completed diagnosis -> 409 diagnosis_not_draft; unknown id -> 404 diagnosis_not_found; unknown company on start -> 404 company_not_found. POST /complete -> 422 incomplete with error.pendingBlocks (array of 1..8) while blocks are missing; 200 with the frozen result otherwise; a second call returns the stored one unchanged.

server/app.ts: AppDependencies gained optional 'rules?: Rules' (defaults to rulesV1) and mounts createDiagnosisRoutes. Tests use it to swap in tests/fixtures/rulesV2.ts for AC-dm-22 and AC-dm-31 (the history unit can do the same with createApp({..., rules: rulesV2})). previous on a completed diagnosis = the newest completed, non-archived diagnosis of the company completed before it; on a draft = the newest completed one.

Remaining checks for integration: 'pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts' once the frontend units land, AC-dm-27 timing of 'Calculando o seu diagnóstico' in the Play (target 3 s), and the harness check.
